summary: This is a routine 6-K filing by Avino Silver & Gold Mines Ltd. reporting voting results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting held on May 27, 2026. All resolutions were passed, including setting the number of directors at five, election of director nominees, and appointment of Deloitte LLP as auditor. Approximately 44.49% of outstanding shares were voted. The 6-K serves as a foreign private issuer's current report under Rule 13a-16, furnishing a press release with standard meeting outcomes. No special-situation event or transaction is disclosed.
